title: Building a tiny queue worker in plain JavaScript

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.

break-inside: avoid listing split into three fragments (planted)

allowed.why: where a block splits and how many lines each fragment carries depends on font metrics and on Chromium's own widows/orphans handling inside the Paged.js fragmentainer

expectedDeclines.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-orphan.md 'Skipped after a forced outgoing break'; the widow rule declines after a forced incoming break (declines list in the rule registry).

mustFire.why: a listing kept in one piece (figure.listing, break-inside: avoid) that is 2.43 content boxes tall
mustFire.construction: 18 px caption + 4 px gap + 130 code lines x 18 px (one display: block span per line, fixed pitch, no wrapping) = 2362 px against 971.34 px (A4, 20 mm): pushed to a fresh page and split 940 + 954 + 468 px
mustFire.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-unbreakable-block-too-tall.md; three or more fragments are summed.

mustNotFire.why: break-inside: avoid blocks that are shorter than the page content box (971.34 px) and are laid out in one piece
table rows carry break-inside: avoid; every row is a single short line of cells, far below the 971.34 px content box

allowed.why: the listing is too tall (18 + 4 + 76 x 18 = 1390 px, 1.43 pages) but splits into exactly two fragments; docs/limitations.md 0.6.0: 'The residual gap is a block split into exactly two fragments whose real height does exceed the page: it is not reported'. A tool that closes the gap may report it.

mustNotFire.why: every one of these headings carries break-after: avoid (Paged.js moves it with the following block) or opens its page, so content follows it on its own page

notes: Not active in the default profile (src/config/contract.ts OFF_BY_DEFAULT_RULE_IDS; docs/rules/layout-half-empty-page.md). Any finding under the default profile fails the gate.

target.pages: any page not named in mustNotFire

allowed.why: a page can end up holding only the text tail of an earlier block when font metrics push the last lines of a flowing section over a page boundary; that is a legitimate finding the construction does not fix
whether a word is split at a page boundary depends on font metrics and on the paginator; the class is only set by Paged.js

notes: The document contains no SVG; the rule has no candidate.

verification.method: probe/construction-probe.mjs: puppeteer-core + Paged.js 0.4.3 UMD bundle only, no code from src/; see PROVENANCE.md

notes: An earlier draft set the listings as a single text node with overflow: hidden; Paged.js then left whitespace and a margin-only fragment in the overflow column and produced fragments taller than the page. The committed version uses one block span per line, which breaks cleanly; the draft was never committed.
